landing.title: Parking at the office
landing.lead: A camera at the entrance reads each number plate and checks it against the permit list. Cars without a permit are reported to the parking team.

request.body: A permanent permit for your own car, or a day permit for a visitor.

decision.body: They approve or reject each request and can leave you a note.

status.body: Open your status link, or enter the reference code and plate.

request.title: Request a parking permit
request.lead: Your request goes to the parking team. You'll get a reference code and a link to check the status.

permanent.title: Permanent permit
permanent.description: For your own car. Valid until revoked.

daily.title: Day permit
daily.description: For one day, e.g. a visitor or a one-off.

plate.hint: As shown on the plate, e.g. ZH 123 456.

note.label: Note
